Compared to 36.101, a special care has been taken in to creating a separate sub-clause for every possible use. This improves the readability much since reader can find correct requirements by searching the section heading list only. There are dedicated sub-section for intra-band contiguous CA, intra-band non-contiguous CA and inter-band CA under every section for example. If you are in doubt, create a new lower level sub-section every time since this helps to add new requirements in future but be careful not to create a hanging paragraph while doing it. Remember to use term “sub-clause” when referring to sub-section. Annex letters are aligned through out the 36.101 and all 38.101 specifications. When creating new Annex’s, special care should be take to use same letters for same purpose.
